description: Returns one saved public prayer-book item: prayer, song, or fixed liturgical text. Bare prayer IDs and namespaced song:<id> and standard:<id> IDs are supported. kind, text_status, and truncated describe content availability; a song can contain only a first line or metadata. rights_note records provenance rather than permission. Text is stored content without generation or network retrieval.

prayer_id.description: Existing bare prayer ID, or exact namespaced prayer_id/item_id (song:<id> or standard:<id>) returned by search or transcript/sermon references.

name: get_prayer
title: Get a public prayer
